description: Z.AI Coding Plan — the plan bills glm-5.1/5.2/5.3 at identical points (6.9/1.7/24 per 1M), so mid-gen flagships are dominated: glm-5.3 codes on pro and judges on max. glm-5.3-flash (2.3/0.56/8, one-third the points, benchmark-parity with glm-5.1) carries the high-traffic standard tier and flash, and doubles as vision (image/video/pdf input). Requires ZHIPU_API_KEY environment variable.
